import json

def parse_result(raw):
    clean = raw.split('\n[stderr]\n', 1)[0].strip()
    # Remove ANSI escape codes
    import re
    clean = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', clean)
    # Remove trailing (.venv) prompt if present
    clean = re.sub(r'\(\.venv\)\s*$', '', clean).strip()
    data = json.loads(clean)
    return data.get("result", data)

import json

def format_product(p):
    lines = []
    lines.append(f"Product ID:    {p.get('product_id', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Name:          {p.get('name', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Category:      {p.get('category', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Price:         ${p.get('price', 'N/A')}")
    if p.get('original_price') and p['original_price'] != p.get('price'):
        lines.append(f"Original Price:${p['original_price']}")
    lines.append(f"Rating:        {p.get('rating', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"In Stock:      {p.get('in_stock', 'N/A')} (Stock: {p.get('stock', 'N/A')})")
    lines.append(f"Shipping Days: {p.get('shipping_days', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Gift Wrap:     {p.get('gift_wrap_available', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Description:   {p.get('description', 'N/A')}")
    if p.get('specs'):
        lines.append("Specs:")
        for k, v in p['specs'].items():
            lines.append(f"  - {k}: {v}")
    if p.get('compatible_with'):
        lines.append(f"Compatible With: {', '.join(p['compatible_with'])}")
    if p.get('recent_price_drop'):
        lines.append(f"Recent Price Drop: {json.dumps(p['recent_price_drop'])}")
    if p.get('active_promotion'):
        lines.append(f"Active Promotion: {json.dumps(p['active_promotion'])}")
    return '\n'.join(lines)

file_content = "# Wireless Mouse Options — Product Details\n"

file_content += f"# Generated: 2026-06-15\n\n"

for i, prod in enumerate([p1, p2, p3], 1):
    file_content += "=" * 60 + "\n"
    file_content += f"  PRODUCT {i}\n"
    file_content += "=" * 60 + "\n"
    file_content += format_product(prod) + "\n\n"
